Independent non-author documentation review: PASS for merged commit be9679dcc4c541c5ab94153920e19af0a317baf7 against leaf parent 2697be85ccc223c245815bc6ad818ebee2915c70. Exactly 49 edited prose blocks were reviewed (27 Python docstrings, 21 Python full-line comment regions, and one shell header); all 49 preserve semantics and remove bloat, reducing 9,344 words to 3,147. Every ticket Scope and named consumer contract is mapped in the preserved_contract_or_consumer cells, including argparse/CLI help, Makefile lint, focused tests, architecture references, workflows, manual operators, and direct imports. Structural review independently proves the exact 18-path set; normalized non-docstring AST identity for all 17 Python paths; exact inline comments, directives, type-ignore state, and shebangs; and exact shell executable lines. Path-scoped diff check passed and the focused contract suite passed 483 tests with one pre-existing Pydantic warning; Gerrit LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and merge are already recorded. Citation basis: 15 parent blobs are byte-identical to frozen audit base 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e, so their before citations retain that base. The three paths with actual mainline drift use the exact leaf parent. An earlier ticket note also named check_verify_gate_parity.py as drifted, but its frozen-base and leaf-parent blob both resolve to f9eafa980169d1bf84876e33cdfee75e297a5c9d, so its frozen-base citation is exact. Final citations are pinned to the merged commit.
